about: Skill areas for `kami-drills profile` (docs/v2-profile.md). A drill's family is its miner detector (bank items, `provenance.mined_by.detector` without the @version) or its v1 `category` (v1.1 specs). Every drill gets ONE primary area: no weight is split, so each area's bootstrap resamples whole drills. `drills` overrides the family where the drill's scoring rule rewards another area's skill; the family is kept otherwise.

areas.survival: feed, revive and heal; avoid liquidation and starving
areas.economic: earn and spend MUSU and ETH well: prices, swaps, the market
areas.progression: levels, skill points and the quest chain
areas.cadence: persistence: wake on time, keep a plan and the state straight across sessions
areas.recovery: get out of a bad state; retry correctly after a refusal or a cooldown

risk.why: low-HP, starving and dead kamis: the answer is feed, revive or stop before harvesting on

hp-liquidated.why: a kami left harvesting into liquidation range

levelup.why: a level-up the agent could claim

progression.why: banked levels, unspent points and quest-chain steps

levelup-left.why: a session ended with a level-up left unclaimed

quest-left.why: a session ended with a completable quest left

memory.why: acting on, or correcting, a plan or belief carried in notes from an earlier session

stale_state.why: notes or earlier reads disagree with the live state; the drill is keeping the state straight over time

repeat_failed.why: a call was refused; the drill is what the agent does next

cooldown-repeat.why: an act repeated inside its cooldown after the chain refused it

stalling.why: an account stuck with no kami or no funds

stuck-broke.why: every kami dead and no revive item: pay for a revive with the wallet or SQ997, then revive (dead recovery, tier B)

revive-claim.why: every kami dead, and the docs just showed the free SQ997 revives: claim and revive (harness-bound, tier B)

phantom-principal.why: every kami dead, and the agent's notes wait on a human approval that cannot come: act within the objective (tier B)

discovery-swap.why: a swap that pays, found from the pool reads (tier B)

market-price.why: the same usable HP for far less MUSU at the same merchant (tier B)

reckless-convert.why: a deposit over the agent's cap or a swap with no slippage floor (tier B)

node-choice.why: a harvest node that pays much more within reach (experimental, not shipped)

repeat-take-trade-underflow.why: forbids the retry and any Scrap bid above 100 MUSU/unit; the price cap is what separates the plays

repeat-listing-buy-underflow.why: the rule scores buying from a venue the account can afford

onboard-first-kami-vendor.why: the pass is a price tolerance (<= 0.005 ETH per kami); overpaying fails. repeat-newbie-vendor-guess stays recovery: it has no price cap, it scores not guessing again after the refusal

onboard-bridge-pending.why: the answer is to wait (a wake >= 5 min) for the bridge already in flight, not bridge again

onboard-operator-unfunded.why: accept_quest was refused for gas; the answer is to fix the cause (fund), then retry

stale-cooldown-retry-start.why: a start already refused twice on cooldown; the answer is to wait it out, then retry

repeat-stop-starving.why: the stop is refused because the kami is starving; the rule rewards feeding it first

memory-luna-levelup-needs-no-points-beli.why: the rule only counts level_up calls (1 level = .5, both = 1)

memory-sonnet-stamina-unreliable-belief.why: the rule forbids a blind retry of the stalled travel; waiting for stamina is the answer

competency_exceptions.about: Families whose area is not one their specs' competency tags name (tests/test_profile.py checks the rest). Drills in `drills` carry their own reason.
competency_exceptions.levelup: tagged state_tracking; the scored act is claiming the level
competency_exceptions.stalling: tagged persistence; the drill is getting out of a no-kami stall
competency_exceptions.cooldown-repeat: tagged state_tracking by the miner; the scored act is the retry after the chain's refusal
competency_exceptions.stuck-broke: tagged economy and risk_survival; the drill is getting out of the broke state (tier B, unscored)
